{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS273 |prevtitle=Red and Blue Make Purple Opponents |nextcode=PS275 |nexttitle=A Vicious Cycle of Possibilities |series=FireRed & LeafGreen |colorscheme=FRLG}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Double Dealing with Deoxys |subtitle=The Ultimate Move Is Revealed |title_ja=発動　究極技 |title_ro=Activate: The Ultimate Move |image=PS274.png |scheme=FireRed & LeafGreen |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 274 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|23}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 274 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|23}} |location=[[Cape Brink]] }} '''Double Dealing with Deoxys''' is the 274th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the seventh chapter of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}. It is subtitled '''The Ultimate Move Is Revealed''' (Japanese: '''発動　究極技''' ''Activate: The Ultimate Move'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{TP|Blue|Scizor}}, with {{TP|Blue|Machamp}} in his pincers, flies above [[Snor]]. Scizor drops Machamp, who proceeds to grab Snor's body. {{adv|Blue}} commands Machamp to use {{m|Seismic Toss}}, so the Superpower Pokémon rolls around and tosses Snor onto the ground. {{adv|Red}} points out that Snor is in trouble against Machamp once again and states that the combination with Scizor increased the damage. Blue commands Machamp to finish Snor off. Machamp rushes in front of Snor and moves to the side to perform a {{m|Low Kick}}, tripping Snor and sending him crashing into the ground, knocking him out. Red comments that the attack was very effective due to Snor's large weight. Outside the building, [[Ultima]] rides on her {{p|Dragonite}}. She comments about how Blue knows how to make full use of his Pokémon during battles. Blue follows by having Scizor attack [[Gyara]] with {{m|Steel Wing}}, knocking him out too. Red sends out [[Pika]] and [[Aero]] as his last two Pokémon. Red has Aero use {{m|Take Down}} on Scizor, which doesn't do [[recoil]] damage due to his {{a|Rock Head}} Ability. Red has Aero use {{m|Dragon Claw}} on Scizor, so Blue switches him out. Seeing an opening, Red has Pika attack Machamp with an electric attack. To Red's surprise, the attack is suddenly redirected. Blue smirks and reveals that he sent out his {{TP|Blue|Rhydon}}, who has the {{a|Lightning Rod|Lightningrod}} Ability, which causes all {{type|Electric}} moves to be redirected towards it. Blue points out that they both only have two Pokémon left, but the winner will be decided by whoever reaches the end first. Blue claims victory, but Red refuses to back down. Red decides that if Pika's Electric attacks won't work, then a body attack will work instead. Pika jumps into the air and delivers an {{m|Iron Tail}} onto Machamp's head. Both Trainers then reach the end at the same time. Exhausted, Red and Blue collapse and attempt to catch their breath. Blue questions who got there first, but Red assumes they arrived at the same time. Blue calls out for Ultima to decide the winner, but gets no response. They go inside to find Ultima, only to see a large shadow looming from above. They look back to see Ultima being choked by the {{adv|Deoxys|Pokémon}} that attacked {{adv|Green}} earlier. Red and Blue send out [[Saur]] and {{TP|Blue|Charizard}}, but the mystery Pokémon grabs them with its tentacles. Red and Blue comment that their situation had to have happened while they were exhausted. The bangles on their arms begin glowing and strange characters appear on them. Ultima struggles to reveal that the attacks they learned were {{m|Frenzy Plant}} and {{m|Blast Burn}}. They quickly realize that Saur and Charizard are reacting, indicating that they have learned the moves Ultima was training them for. With no time to lose, Red commands Saur to use Frenzy Plant while Blue has Charizard use Blast Burn. ==Major events== * {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}}'s battle ends in a tie. * [[Ultima]] is attacked by {{adv|Deoxys}}. * [[Saur]] and {{TP|Blue|Charizard}} learn {{m|Frenzy Plant}} and {{m|Blast Burn}}, respectively. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * [[Ultima]]/{{tt|Kimberly|Chuang Yi}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Snorlax}} ([[Snor]]/{{tt|Lax|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Gyara]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Aerodactyl}} ([[Aero]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Scizor}} ({{OP|Blue|Scizor}}) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Blue|Charizard}}) * {{p|Machamp}} ({{OP|Blue|Machamp}}) * {{p|Rhydon}} ({{OP|Blue|Rhydon}}) * {{p|Ditto}} ([[Ditty]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Dragonite}} ([[Ultima]]'s) * {{p|Deoxys}} ({{adv|Deoxys|Adventures}}; {{DL|Deoxys (Adventures)|Organism No. 1}}/{{tt|Entity One|Chuang Yi}}; {{form|Deoxys|Normal Forme}}; {{m|transform}}ed [[Ditty]]) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|FRLG}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|FRLG}} |zh_yue={{tt|發動究極技|Activate the ultimate technique}} |zh_cmn={{tt|究極技發動|Ultimate technique activation}} (Taiwan)
